tasks.title: Verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
Run the complete test suite using npm test. Verify that:
1. The command exits with code 0
2. All test files execute successfully (src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx)
3. No failures, errors, or warnings appear in the output

Report the test results including:
- Total number of tests run
- Number of passing tests
- Any failures or errors (if present)
- Exit code of the test command
acceptance_criteria: No test failures or warnings in output
